name: Diagnose CI Failure
summary: Diagnose a failing CI run from supplied logs and repository evidence without mutating workflows or rerunning jobs.
description: A bounded command wrapper around the CI failure procedure and specialist. It collects the failing step, ranks evidence-backed hypotheses, and returns discriminating checks without changing CI state.
refuses: Do not rerun, cancel, approve, or mutate any CI job or workflow.
Do not claim a root cause from a downstream error without causal evidence.
Do not inspect unrelated logs, secrets, or repository areas outside the bounded failure.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate declared local command preconditions before the prompt workflow may continue.

produces: a ranked CI failure diagnosis with cited log evidence, competing hypotheses, and the next discriminating check
requires: the failing job, step, or bounded log excerpt must be identified by the user

flags.name: job
flags.description: Restrict diagnosis to one named CI job or step.
